issues.description: Method name mismatch for the operation that adds a parent relationship. The problem statement and template declare and document a service method addParent(Person person, Person parent) (used by the REST controller and tests). The template's PersonService has a stub for addParent(Person, Person). The solution's PersonService instead defines registerParent(Person person, Person parent) (no addParent implementation). Meanwhile PersonResource and the tests call personService.addParent(...). This inconsistent identifier (registerParent vs addParent) means callers expecting addParent will not find that method on the provided service API, causing compilation failures and confusing students who try to map the specification to the solution code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the service API name consistent with the problem statement, template, controller, and tests. Rename the solution's registerParent(Person, Person) method to addParent(Person, Person) so it matches callers, or add a public addParent(Person, Person) method that delegates to registerParent. Update any references accordingly to ensure the service exposes addParent(Person, Person).
